::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Pune-based, founded 2022. iDEX (Ministry of Defence) awardee, taped out its core beamforming IC under the DLI scheme.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Beamforming ASICs (800 MHz–18 GHz) and electronically steered antenna systems for radar, satellite, 5G, and defence applications, plus an antenna-testing device (VASATD1).
